build: The files every build used to rewrite by hand are written by one tool, tools/shared.cjs, from the code and from each build's own file here. The label and the list behind "What changed" leave js/main.js and js/changes.js for a script of their own, js/built.js, which the tool writes: the build before's list, and at its head this build's entry ("changes" in this file) with the next label and the day. index.html no longer carries the label; sw.js is written by the same tool. tools/take_main.sh takes main into a branch and settles these files, and tests/counts.json check by check, by itself; .github/workflows/take-main.yml does it for every open pull request when main moves. The checks find the "What changed" sheet by hooks (data-hook), which no style uses. Nothing looks different, and no date, yield, price, seed count or bench figure changes.

changes.did: Nothing looks different. The build’s number and this list are now written by the step that merges a build, so that two builds can be made side by side.
steps: Press the build’s number beside the farm’s name: this build is at the head of the list, marked “New”, and every build before it is listed as before, latest first.
Open Backup: its last line says the same number.
